traits.desc: Nearby weather responds to the sazakan’s desires. At the start of each hr sazakan can choose to change the precipitation and temperature within 1 mile of it by one stage up or down (no action required). This works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the control weather spell except sazakan can’t change wind conditions change immediately and sazakan can never make it warm hot or unbearable heat.
